newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Optimus extends surge on good earnings.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Optimus extends surge on good earnings.

text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus SA surged 9.6 percent to 80 zlotys in a 5.9-million-zloty- turnover, extending its Wednesday's 9.8-percent jump on the back of strong December earnings, traders said.
"The good earnings help the stock keep rising and generally the stock fundamentally looks good," one trader said.
Optimus showed a 5.9-million-zloty net profit in December and 16.5-million-zloty net in 1996.
Analysts said that the stock was still likely to rise, after it recorded strong buying after price fixing on Thursday.
